description: This script automates the process of cloning, validating, organizing, and merging multiple Git repositories, specifically for managing language packs in the context of the AnySoftKeyboard project.

methods.name: clone_locally
methods.description: Clones a repository locally and resets it to a specific commit.

methods.name: ensure_valid
methods.description: Checks the repository for illegal objects and repairs it if necessary.

methods.name: move_to_sub_folder
methods.description: Moves repository files into a designated subfolder for organization.

methods.name: ready_clone
methods.description: Performs cloning, validation, and organization of a repository.

methods.name: assemble_into_main
methods.description: Merges a repository's history into the main project and moves files into the target folder.
